rows.sentence: According to `doc.txt`, the section "Examples of ISPs Becoming Edge Providers" describes the following actions:
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The section has this title and describes actions taken or announced by AT&T, Comcast, and Verizon.

rows.sentence: "In 2018, AT&T acquired Time Warner, a content creator that owns HBO and its affiliated edge provider HBO NOW, as well as other cable channels."
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The context explicitly states the acquisition date and identifies Time Warner as the owner of HBO, HBO NOW, and other cable channels.

rows.sentence: "AT&T has announced plans to introduce a new edge provider—HBO Max—to stream video programming for no extra charge to AT&T customers who are also HBO subscribers; other customers will reportedly be charged a subscription fee."
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The context states that AT&T announced HBO Max and gives the same reported pricing terms.

rows.sentence: "In 2011, Comcast became the majority owner of NBCUniversal, which owns television networks and broadcast stations, and thus obtained minority ownership of Hulu, an edge provider that streams video programming to subscribers."
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The context confirms the date, NBCUniversal's holdings, and how the deal gave Comcast a minority stake in Hulu.

rows.sentence: "Comcast also announced plans to launch its own video streaming service, Peacock," with three planned subscription options: "a free option supported by ads, a premium version with more programming for a fee, and the premium version with no ads for a higher fee," with "The premium version is to be offered for free to subscribers of Comcast and Cox Communications."
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The context confirms the Peacock launch announcement, the three reported subscription options, and the planned free premium offer for Comcast and Cox subscribers.

rows.sentence: "In 2015, Verizon acquired AOL, an ISP and edge provider, and in 2016, it acquired the core business of Yahoo, an edge provider."
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The context gives the same acquisition dates and distinguishes the AOL acquisition from the acquisition of Yahoo's core business.

rows.sentence: "It combined the edge provider products from these acquisitions—such as Yahoo Finance, Huffington Post, TechCrunch, and Engadget—in 2017 to create Oath."
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The context explicitly states that Verizon combined the listed products in 2017 to create Oath.

rows.sentence: In short, the document presents three approaches: acquiring existing content/edge businesses (AT&T's acquisition of Time Warner; Comcast's majority ownership of NBCUniversal; Verizon's acquisitions of AOL and Yahoo), and launching or combining their own edge products (HBO Max, Peacock, and Oath).
rows.label: supported
rows.rationale: The examples support all three approaches: acquiring businesses, announcing plans for new streaming services, and combining acquired products into Oath.
